description: Free detail lookup for exactly one paid route. Input is the route path such as /iban or /transfer; the result is a JSON object with its price in USDC, parameters it needs, what it checks, limits and 402/404 behavior. Returns a short error text "Unknown route ... Call list_routes" if the path does not exist. Use it after choose_route or list_routes when you know which route you want and need its exact inputs before paying. Read-only: it does not call the route and spends no USDC.

path.description: Route path starting with a slash, exactly as shown by list_routes or choose_route, for example /iban, /transfer or /deadline.

name: describe_route
